connector.name: OpenProject
connector.registryDescription: Manage OpenProject projects, work packages, files, relations, boards, users, and notifications.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package openproject-codex-plugin. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alex13slem account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENPROJECT_AUTH_MODE
env.description: API-token authentication mode: basic for broad compatibility or bearer for OpenProject 17.2+

env.name: OPENPROJECT_ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DIRS
env.description: Platform-separated directories from which attachment files may be read; defaults to the process working directory
